meta.scope: Brazil offshore pre-salt gas infrastructure, tariffs, plants, market, regulation (Santos Basin blocks Rodocrosita, Rubi, Itaimbezinho, Jaspe; neighbour Bacalhau)
meta.note: value=null means UNKNOWN (not found in a fetched public source). Source ids map to the table in brazil_gas_infrastructure_tariffs_market.md
meta.source_id_convention: INF-S<n> keys of `sources` in this file; analogue/market file uses MKT-S<n>
meta.stale_warning: Snapshot of public sources read on 2026-10-14. Tariffs, capacities, start dates and regulation change; re-check before use.
meta.unknown_convention: value null (or confidence UNKNOWN) means not found in a fetched public source; it is not zero.

pipelines.name: Rota 1 (Tupi/Lula - Mexilhao - UTGCA Caraguatatuba)
pipelines.owner: Tupi-Mexilhao: Petrobras 65 / Shell 25 / Galp 10; Mexilhao-UTGCA: Petrobras 100 (2019 data)
pipelines.status_2026: operating (per 2021-26 GEM page; not re-verified by Petrobras page)

pipelines.name: Rota 2 (Tupi/Lula - Buzios corridor - UTGCAB Cabiunas)
pipelines.status_2026: operating (Petrobras page: in operation since 12 Feb 2016)
pipelines.note: capacity and diameter official; length and ownership from S4 (press/secondary)

pipelines.name: Rota 3 (pre-salt Santos - UPGN Boaventura/GASLUB Itaborai)
pipelines.landfall: Jacone beach, Marica RJ (48 km onshore to Itaborai)
pipelines.status_2026: operating; commercial operation Sep-Nov 2024; ANP rejected Petrobras gas-spec waiver for Itaborai 2026-10-02
pipelines.note: 307 km offshore + 48 km onshore; diameter UNKNOWN

pipelines.name: Rota 4A (pre-salt - Praia Grande - Cubatao)
pipelines.owner: Rota 4 Participacoes (Compass/Cosan, Comgas); minority partners sought
pipelines.status_2026: proposed / licensing; not in EPE PDE 2035 base case (planned export pipelines there: Raia, SEAP)
pipelines.note: GEM quotes 275-291 km and 10-21 MMm3/d; 2020 article expected start 2027-28; start year UNKNOWN now

pipelines.name: Rota 4B (pre-salt - Itaguai, Ilha da Madeira)
pipelines.landfall: Itaguai RJ (294 km offshore + 19 km onshore)

pipelines.name: Raia gas export pipeline (BM-C-33, Equinor)
pipelines.owner: Equinor-operated Raia project (partners not verified here)
pipelines.status_2026: ANP authorised start of construction July 2025; offshore processing, gas enters transport grid directly

pipelines.name: Rota 5 / Rota 6 / SPA (Santos Basin pre-salt)
pipelines.status_2026: UNKNOWN; 2019 plan named Rotas 4,5,6; PIPE 2021 mentions Rotas 5A/5B/5C as hub-export alternatives

pipelines.name: Bacalhau gas route
pipelines.owner: Equinor 40 (op) / ExxonMobil 40 / Petrogal 20; PPSA contract manager
pipelines.status_2026: Phase 1 on stream Oct 2025, no export pipeline; Phase 2 concept studies include 2nd FPSO plus approx 100-mile (about 160 km) gas pipeline (Reuters via JPT 2022); route/tie-in UNKNOWN
pipelines.note: reinjection statement from S9 (press, 2022); MODEC says FPSO 'process and inject up to 530 MMscfd associated gas'

plants.name: Boaventura / GASLUB UPGN, Itaborai RJ
plants.tpa: no published TPA terms; ANP draft third-party-access resolution in consultation (Jul 2026)
plants.note: two trains; 2nd module on stream May 2025 (S11 official); feed up to 18 MMm3/d via Rota 3; gas ethane-rich; mitigation blend with Cabiunas gas, etanized gas to REDUC via Gasduc II and Gaserj (S19)

plants.name: UTGCAB Cabiunas (Macae RJ)
plants.tpa: existing UPGN sharing contracts (e.g. Cabiunas, Caraguatatuba) per EPE; terms not public
plants.note: largest installed processing capacity in Brazil (EPE PDE 2034)

plants.name: UTGCA Caraguatatuba SP
plants.tpa: existing UPGN sharing contracts per EPE; ANP granted spec waiver (no selective ethane separation)
plants.note: capacity UNKNOWN; EPE PDE 2035 model uses up to 10 MMm3/d supply from UTGCA (PDE 2034: up to 15)

plants.name: Brazil national UPGN fleet
plants.owner: Petrobras about 90 percent of capacity (ANP yearbook 2024 cited by Poder360)
plants.note: 14 UPGNs in operation: 91.2 SE / 16.7 NE / 12.2 N (PDE 2035); PDE 2034 had 12 UPGNs, 98.7 MMm3/d

plants.name: Mexilhao UTG, Boaventura refinery, RPBC, REDUC
plants.note: RPBC UPGN authorisation revoked 2023 (PDE 2034); Boaventura refining 2028 (PDE 2035); REDUC receives etanized gas (S19); other numbers UNKNOWN

regulation.name: Gas Law 14.134/2021
regulation.value: entry-exit transport regime; ANP-approved tariffs; access to escoamento, processing and LNG terminals

regulation.name: Resolucao ANP 982/2025 (21 May 2025)
regulation.value: gas specification incl. methane/ethane limits with waiver for pre-salt processing units; ANP rejected Petrobras waiver for Itaborai on 2026-10-02 but granted similar to UTGCA

regulation.name: Lei 15.042/2024 (SBCE, Brazilian GHG ETS)
regulation.value: creates SBCE, operator monitoring plan and annual emission reporting; allocation, caps and price UNKNOWN here

regulation.name: Lei 13.586/2017 (Repetro-Sped)
regulation.value: special import regime suspending II, IPI, PIS/COFINS-import for definitive-stay goods used in E&P

regulation.name: Lei 12.351/2010 individualisation of production
regulation.value: unitisation of adjacent areas via Acordo de Individualizacao da Producao; PPSA/Union defines AIP terms with adjacent-area holder (Chapter IV)
